subject: gk
question: The black soil of the Deccan Plateau lacks which of the following minerals?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Phosphorous**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Black Soil**

 
 
• These soils are also known as the ‘Regur Soil’ or the &Black Cotton Soil’.
 
• The black soils are generally clayey, deep, and impermeable.
 
• They swell and become sticky when wet and shrink when dried. 
 
• So, during the dry season, this soil develops **wide cracks. Thus, there occurs a kind of ‘self-plowing’.**
 
• The black soils are rich in **lime, iron, magnesia, and alumina and also contain potash**.
 
• They lack phosphorous, nitrogen, and organic matter.
 
• The color of the soil ranges from **deep black to grey**.
 
• Along with cotton, the soil is suitable for the cultivation of crops like **groundnut, tobacco, chilies, and Jowar**.
 
• It has a pH of 6.8.
 
• Thus, there occurs a kind of *‘self ploughing’.*
 
• they lack phosphorous, nitrogen and organic matter.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
